thread:
megan: Quick thread — final copy pass for the Hosted/Dedicated/Private landing trio. Need one clean set for the launch post and webinar promo by EOD.

dave: On it. Do we have a single hero that covers all three modes or mode-specific hero lines?
sara: I'd vote for a single hero sentence + mode toggles below. Keeps cognitive load low on the page.
leo: Agree. Hero: 'Predictable, production-grade inference — wherever you run it.' Subline could be 'Hosted, Dedicated, or Private deployments with one consistent API.'
megan: Love that. Can we make the subline more benefit-driven for infra teams for Private? Maybe add "enterprise controls" mention in the toggle copy.
ria: For toggles: Hosted = "Get started fast — hosted API & free credits"; Dedicated = "Reserved capacity and SLA-backed throughput"; Private = "VPC & on-prem options with KMS integrations"
ashley: For the launch post, we should surface benchmark callouts: e.g., "<2x latency vs default" is too vague — we have per-model numbers from the perf team. Any objections to a small benchmark strip under hero?
dave: Use a subtle ribbon: "Benchmarks: median p50 latency on common open models" and link to the benchmark page. Avoid over-claiming.
sara: Webinar blurb copy: "Live demo + cost-saving playbook: How we cut per-token cost with batching & KV caching" — want to drive signups for technical PMs/engineers.
megan: Good. CTA for webinar should be separate from demo CTA. Button text options: "Watch demo" vs "Reserve spot". Prefer "Reserve spot" for scarcity.
leo: Inbound routing notes: If someone signs up for webinar, tag as "engaging: webinar" and route to growth inbox; product-marketing follow-up within 48h. If they demo-request, auto-route to AE queue with plan type prefilled (hosted/dedicated/private).
ria: I'll add the tag mapping to the inbound playbook. Quick config snippet for routing (for docs team):
```yaml
routes:
  - event: webinar_signup
    tag: engaging:webinar
    dest: growth_inbox
  - event: demo_request
    tag: sales:demo
    dest: ae_queue
```
ashley: Love the snippet. Also include a short FAQ line under Private: "Supported: VPC peering, HSM/KMS, audit logs, on-prem bundles" so security folks see it immediately.
dave: Marketing-bot: remind in 24h to pull final approved hero for A/B test variants.
marketing-bot: Reminder scheduled for 24 hours.
sara: For the launch social post, short variant: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower unit costs. Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, or Private deployments — your inference, your rules. Reserve our launch webinar."
megan: I'll collate these and post a content readout at 3pm. If anyone has final edits, drop them here before 2:30pm. :thumbsup:
leo: Quick nit — change "lower unit costs" to "reliable unit economics" (less price-y).
megan: Done. Final pass incoming. Thanks all!
